about: Which way each StuyTown / Peter Cooper Village apartment line faces and how much direct sun it gets, by floor. Built by tools/sun_map/build.py; read with unit_sun.py. For each address: 'spots' are apartment positions on a typical floor (windows' compass directions, Oval, street, and sun per floor 1..top_floor as [morning h, afternoon h, Dec 21 h, Dec 21 morning h, sun score], the hours averaged over the 21st of every month, trees taken off floors 1-5); 'lines' gives, for each letter, which spot(s) it is with probabilities, its expected sun score per floor ('score', 0-100) and its percentile among all lines on that floor ('pct'). Sun score = morning + 0.75 x afternoon + 0.5 x min(morning, afternoon, 1.5) in full-sun hours (sun straight in counts 1, skimming the wall ~0; Oct-Mar count 1.5x), scaled so 100 = the sunniest lines; 'lines' gives, for each letter, which spot(s) it is, with probabilities. Confidence: sure (the building's own plan, or a same-design building confirmed by listings), likely, either way (two fits equally good), unknown.
